baseline.notes: Identify the exact canonical state used as the rebuild baseline.

public_record_content_boundary.process_history_surface: this manifest or a governed review/audit artefact
public_record_content_boundary.notes: Keep accepted occurrence-specific reasoning in the Incident; keep rejected/no-mapping candidate inventories and process history in this manifest or dated audits. Do not create a separate global class-by-Incident adjudication dataset.
public_record_content_boundary.clause_level_adjudication_surface: vigil_assessment.source_clause_analysis.clauses[] and taxonomy_classification in the canonical Incident

evidence_search.notes: Record actual source searches, source-level evidence, decisive primary artefacts pursued, and genuine access limits; do not mark performed before execution.

source_first_discovery.notes: Complete this analysis from source evidence and current taxonomy before consulting the old mapping shortlist. Include materially engaged failure, successful and unresolved properties. Record decisive source searches before rejecting a candidate for missing evidence; preserve material gaps without inventing a class. Empty arrays are not evidence of completed review.

taxonomy_review.notes: First recover governed propositions independently. Record every materially plausible class with occurrence-specific necessary-condition and exclusion findings; a true flag alone does not establish coverage.

independent_adjudication.notes: Dated review output only. Each mapping decision tests the literal versioned recognition conditions and exclusions against episode/source evidence, distinguishes external claims from VIGIL's result, and dispositions prior VIGIL divergences. See the workflow and dated protocol design. Empty arrays mean not yet reviewed, not clean pass.
independent_adjudication.canonical_boundary_adjudication_note: Every retained or newly admitted ambiguous-boundary mapping must carry completed boundary_adjudication in the Incident, using vigil/templates/boundary-adjudication-template.json. Boundary mappings require completed boundary_adjudication and must omit classification_confidence. Failure-occurrence and successful-invariant mappings require classification_confidence (low, medium or high) and must omit boundary_adjudication. On a role change, preserve the previous mapping and superseded values in dated review history before removing role-inapplicable fields from the current mapping. Historical confidence is provenance, never a current Boundary rating. Audit packets supplement, never replace, this canonical explanation. Unsupported engagement and pending review cannot satisfy it.
independent_adjudication.condition_decision_guidance: For each necessary failure and success condition: quote the literal condition, assign established/contradicted/unknown, provide unique condition-specific evidentiary reasoning, episode/source references, contrary evidence and missing facts. Repeating the mapping-wide classification_basis as the reason for every condition is not an independent assessment.
independent_adjudication.exclusion_decision_guidance: For each literal exclusion: assign established/contradicted/unknown and cite occurrence-specific evidence. Any established operative exclusion defeats admission as failure, success OR Boundary. An unknown decisive exclusion is a pending candidate review, not a clean pass; an explicit uncertainty-based exclusion is tested against that uncertainty. Other mapped classes are not automatic exclusions.

harm_review.notes: State whether all VIGIL-HIM dimensions were reopened and whether later consequence evidence was searched.

governance_interpretation_review.notes: State how the integrated conclusion was rebuilt after evidence, taxonomy and harm adjudication.

semantic_preservation_review.notes: Compare the exact baseline and candidate. A passed structural rebuild guard does not certify absence of semantic loss. Maintain negative candidate history in this per-Incident manifest/audit, not a canonical cross-product dataset.

escalation.notes: Use a confirmed GitHub Issue only for a genuine actionable follow-up. Search existing issues before creating one; preserve a ready-to-file payload if writes fail. Legacy queue transition is a separate one-time task.

decision_completion.notes: The canonical adjudication_coverage.status describes statuses of listed clauses only; it cannot certify evidence completeness or substantive adjudication. Do not claim final completion while any decisive packet stage remains initial/pending/not-reviewed. Record evidence-limited conclusions honestly.
